title: Heading and exactly two cards are displayed
test_data: Expected heading (h2): What Sets Us Apart? ; cards: One Stop Shop, Make It Easy
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Scroll slowly from top to bottom so every section is revealed (some sections are hidden until scrolled into view)
Look at the "What Sets Us Apart?" section
expected_result: The h2 "What Sets Us Apart?" is visible with exactly 2 cards: "One Stop Shop" and "Make It Easy".
